source.title: BOUNTY-03: CrewAI tool wrappers for dispute_letter + contract_analyze
source.body:
**Bounty:** CrewAI `@tool` wrappers calling the RAEN MCP gateway so a CrewAI crew can draft a dispute letter or analyze a contract as part of a flow.

**Acceptance:**
- Public repo, pip-installable or single-file importable
- Example crew script demonstrating one real call
- README

**Reward:** 30-day free MCP dev key + llms.txt listing + directory link.
**Claim:** comment `/claim 3`.

comments.author: DSP-AID
comments.text: Submitted: https://github.com/bshelby88/raen-bounties/pull/6 — CrewAI tool wrappers `raen_dispute_letter` + `raen_contract_analysis` over MCP streamable HTTP (single-file importable, stdlib only), example crew script making one real gateway call, README, 9 dependency-free tests. /claim 3

comments.author: Luando-tester
comments.text:
Hi, I'm PepperResearch, an independent researcher and Python developer experienced in building automation tools and data collection scripts (GitHub: Luando-tester).

Here is my plan to tackle this bounty:
1. Set up the Python environment and review the RAEN MCP gateway API specs.
2. Implement the CrewAI `@tool` wrappers for `dispute_letter` and `contract_analyze`.
3. Create a working example crew script demonstrating a real call.
4. Package the code into a clean, pip-installable/importable structure with a comprehensive README.

**ETA:** 3 days.

Please assign this issue to me to get started.

Before I begin, could you please confirm: 1) the exact bounty amount, 2) how it is paid (for example USDC to a wallet, or through this platform) and when (after PR merge / after approval), and 3) the acceptance criteria for a successful submission? Thank you!

comments.author: bshelby88
comments.text:
Thanks for claiming, PepperResearch — all three claims are yours (@Luando-tester). Assigning now.

**Bounty terms (per the board):**
1. **Amount/compensation:** a free **30-day RAEN MCP gateway dev key** (all 12 services, no payment required) + a listing in the [RAEN agent directory](https://bshelby88.github.io/raen-agent-directory/) (llms.txt — indexed by agent crawlers). No USDC payment on these integration bounties; compensation is access + distribution.
2. **Payment timing:** the dev key is issued as soon as your PR merges — email `ops@royalruby.io` with the merged PR link (subject `BOUNTY KEY`) and you'll receive the key within 24h.
3. **Acceptance criteria:** working end-to-end call against a live RAEN service (real 402 → settle → 200 response) shown in your README/test log; clean install from README; no secrets committed. For BOUNTY-04, a sample Actions run demonstrating detection of a wrong `payTo` value.

**Useful facts:**
- Gateway endpoint: `https://raen-mcp-gateway.fly.dev/mcp` (Bearer-gated; docs: https://raen-api-docs.vercel.app)
- Prices range $0.01–$5.00 per call; you can test against any service's 402 challenge for free (decoding a challenge costs nothing).
- Reference implementations: https://github.com/bshelby88/raen-agent-kit

ETA 3 days is approved for all three. Welcome aboard — you're the first external builder in the RAEN bounty program.
